items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al McKibbon on Tape 1, 33:09-35:26 bass... [listing other band members like John Brown, Hen Gates, Willie Kirk, etc.]

ctx.x: ...the third alto player, John Brown, first [alto saxophone]. Um...uh there was [James] “Hen Gates” [Forman] on piano, Willie Kirk on trumpet. Um...Al McKibbon on Tape 1, 33:09-35:26 bass, [Louis] “Sabu” Martinez, conga drum. Um...Lamar Brothers[?] on trumpet, uh J.J. Johnson on trombone, Sam Most, trombone.
